issue_context.title: sql: CREATE EXTENSION does not pretty-print properly
issue_context.body:
**Describe the problem**

CREATE EXTENSION accepts identifiers, which may contain punctuation. However, this is not pretty-printed properly.


**To Reproduce**

`CREATE EXTENSION "a-b"`



Jira issue: CRDB-27197
Epic: CRDB-28893

review_comments: `ctx.FormatNode(node.Name)` is better / more code re-usey right?
`FormatNode` removes the identifier when performing redaction. Which is exactly what we don't want here.
